summary: D-MARKET Electronic Services & Trading (d/b/a Hepsiburada, NASDAQ: HEPS), a Turkish e-commerce platform, furnished a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of an Extraordinary General Assembly held August 14, 2026, with the press release dated August 20. Shareholders approved an increase in total share capital and matters of pre-emptive rights under Article 461/2 of the Turkish Commercial Code, along with amending Article 6 of the Articles of Association on Capital; a quorum was present. The board resolved to inform shareholders and proceed with the capital increase process. No price, stake, or deal terms were disclosed; no advisor named. Watch the timing and dilution from the capital raise.
